_comment: Fail-closed allowlists. api_hosts: hosts the generators may call (subdomains included). output_host_suffixes: hosts that may appear in URLs written into manifests (subdomains included). static_asset_urls: exact URLs that are allowed in manifests although their host is not allowlisted (reviewed, hard-coded in config/games.json). Add an entry only after verifying it is an official vendor domain.
